other_conditions: Applicant must be an Indian national
PhD must have been awarded within the last four years from the application deadline
Applicant should have a first‑class academic record throughout their academic career
Applicant should submit a strong research proposal aligned with PRL’s research areas
Applicants must arrange recommendation letters from at least three non‑PRL referees, emailed directly to the Chairperson, PDF Committee
benefits_summary: Scholars receive a monthly scholarship of ₹1,00,000 plus HRA and other facilities for a maximum of two years (extendable by one year).
documents_required: Recommendation letters from at least three non‑PRL referees
